Here’s a quick rundown of the tools you can use:

**File System Operations**
| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `cd(folder)` | Change to a sub‑directory (one level at a time). |
| `ls(a)` | List directory contents; `a=True` shows hidden files. |
| `pwd()` | Show current working directory. |
| `mkdir(dir_name)` | Create a new directory. |
| `rmdir(dir_name)` | Remove an empty directory. |
| `rm(file_name)` | Delete a file. |
| `touch(file_name)` | Create an empty file. |
| `cp(source, destination)` | Copy a file or directory. |
| `mv(source, destination)` | Move or rename a file/directory. |
| `cat(file_name)` | Display file contents. |
| `tail(file_name, lines)` | Show the last `n` lines of a file. |
